fixed_method: Enumerate all unique joined-store ticks and all real-game segments before applying the covering-only sensitivity subset. Join archived S06 and S88 series on (game_id, ts), reproduce each archived headline before computing covering-only results, do not relabel ticks, and do not refit a model.
metric: Share of scored MLB in-game ticks whose real-game segment does not cover its ticker's encoded ET date. Date-unknown rows stay in each readout population and are reported separately.
seal_canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON serialized with sort_keys=true and separators=(comma,colon), after removing seal_sha256.
